title: Emperor Basil II (Bulgar Slayer)
biography: The most formidable military ruler of the Byzantine Empire; expanded frontiers from the Danube to Syria, established the Varangian Guard, and presided over the golden intellectual renaissance of Constantinople.
internationalConnections: Married his sister Anna Porphyrogenita to Prince Vladimir the Great of Kievan Rus', leading to the Christianization of the Rus'.
